concept.title: Workers and jobseekers
concept.shortdesc: People in or looking for work, including professionals and staff who use or refer to a service and unemployed people facing barriers to employment.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Workers, service providers and professionals of any kind who use, run or refer to a service.
: People who are out of work, have lost a job or are looking for work, including those facing barriers to employment.
